quizzes.title: Networking Basics
quizzes.description: Network edge, packet switching, and introductory network services.

questions.text: Which transport protocol provides a reliable ordered byte stream?
Which device normally forwards IP packets between different networks?
In store-and-forward packet switching, what must a router do before sending a packet on its next link?

options.A: Reserve a circuit for the entire session
options.D: Convert the packet into a DNS record

questions.text: Which protocol resolves a domain name to an IP address?
What is the default TCP port for HTTPS?

quizzes.title: Transport Layer and Reliability
quizzes.description: Transport services, demultiplexing, TCP flow control, acknowledgements, and reliable transfer.

questions.text: Which transport protocol offers connectionless datagram delivery?
Which layer provides process-to-process delivery between applications on different hosts?
Which TCP mechanism limits a sender according to the receiving host's available buffer space?
Which TCP header field names the receiving service port?
Because TCP carries a byte stream, how can an application recover its own message boundaries?

options.A: Treat each sendall call as one received message
options.B: Use a length prefix or delimiter in its application protocol
options.C: Treat each TCP segment as one application message
options.D: Use each ACK as an application delimiter

questions.text: What does a UDP checksum help a receiver do?
A TCP receiver has received bytes numbered 200 through 239 in order. What cumulative ACK number indicates the next expected byte?
In Selective Repeat, what can the receiver do when a correct packet arrives after a missing earlier packet?

options.B: Immediately deliver all later data to the application
options.C: Discard every later packet without an ACK

quizzes.title: Application Layer and Internet Services
quizzes.description: HTTP, email, DNS, caching, and content delivery.

questions.text: Which HTTP method requests a representation of a resource without submitting an update?
Which HTTP status code means the requested resource was not found?
What allows HTTP/2 messages from several streams to share one connection?

options.A: One new TCP connection for each object
options.C: A separate DNS query for each frame
options.D: A single response with no framing

questions.text: How can a web application associate separate stateless HTTP requests with one signed-in user?

options.A: By relying only on the TCP port number
options.B: By assuming HTTP remembers earlier requests
options.C: By changing the user's IP address
options.D: By using a cookie or token linked to server-side session state

questions.text: A cached object has not changed after a conditional GET. Which response avoids sending the object body again?
Which protocol transfers an email between the sending and receiving mail servers?
Which mailbox-access protocol synchronizes messages and flags across several devices?
Which DNS record type identifies a mail server for a domain?
During an iterative DNS lookup, what may a contacted DNS server return instead of the final address?

options.A: A referral to another DNS server
options.B: A TCP ACK for the resolver's next byte

questions.text: What is a main purpose of mapping a video request to a CDN edge server?

options.B: To require every request to reach one distant origin
options.C: To serve content from a suitable edge based on path, load and content

quizzes.title: Socket Programming and Communication
quizzes.description: UDP/TCP socket calls, encoding, framing, threads, and transfer verification.

questions.text: Which Python socket type is used for a UDP datagram socket?
What extra information does Python's recvfrom() return with the bytes of a UDP datagram?
What does binding a server socket to 0.0.0.0 mean?

options.B: Connect to an Internet server at 0.0.0.0
options.C: Listen on all local IPv4 interfaces

questions.text: After a TCP listening socket accepts a client, which socket should the server use to exchange data with that client?

options.B: The new connected socket returned by accept()

questions.text: Which call does the TCP client use to open a connection to the chosen server host and port?
What does recv() returning an empty bytes object usually indicate in a TCP connection?

options.A: The peer closed its sending side
options.B: The next message is empty but the peer remains open
options.C: The receiver obtained a UDP checksum
options.D: The socket automatically retries the read

questions.text: Why might a UDP client set a socket timeout before waiting for a reply?

options.B: To increase the server's port number
options.C: To avoid waiting indefinitely when no reply arrives

questions.text: Before passing a Python text message to sendto(), what should the program do?

options.A: Convert it to a DNS record

questions.text: What does struct.Struct('!I') represent when used for a protocol length field?

options.A: A one-byte signed integer in host byte order
options.D: A four-byte unsigned integer in network byte order

questions.text: Why is a helper such as recv_exact(sock, 4) useful when reading a four-byte field from TCP?

options.A: Because one recv(4) always returns exactly four bytes
options.B: Because TCP identifies each application field
options.C: Because recv may return fewer bytes, so the reader must loop
options.D: Because four bytes always contain an entire file

questions.text: After starting worker threads, which threading operation waits for a worker to finish?
When can a file receiver safely treat a transfer as complete?

options.A: As soon as the TCP connection closes
options.B: When byte count, block count and SHA-256 all match metadata
options.C: When the first file block arrives
options.D: When the sender calls sendall() once
